purpose: Twenty generated ElevenLabs sound effects, downloaded and integrated in Night Shift.
delivery: Original WAV masters, prepared WAVs and compressed browser MP3s are included in the sound pack.

assets.prompt: Quiet night wind around a tiny abandoned roadside trailer camp, sparse insects, occasional faint rusty metal creaks and a faraway restrained electrical hum. Eerie, intimate and understated. Seamless outdoor ambience loop, no music, no voices, no zombies or gunfire.

A light metal trailer door swings outward on dry hinges, a short uneven hinge squeak and gentle panel rattle, ending without a slam. One opening action. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.
assets.trigger: Door begins opening before a passage

assets.prompt: A metal trailer door closes with a restrained hollow clunk, its loose panel rattles briefly and the latch clicks into place. One closure, no excessive slam. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.
assets.trigger: Door closes after the survivor clears it

assets.prompt: A tired adult man takes a small breath then releases a long weary resigned sigh, as if facing the same unpleasant nightly chore again. Natural understated performance, wordless, no theatrical groan. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation.

One heavy work boot takes a grounded step onto gritty cracked asphalt, a firm heel impact, slight sole compression and a small gravel crunch. One step only, no rhythm or walking sequence. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.

A small portion of food frying in a cast-iron skillet inside a trailer, fine irregular sizzling and tiny oily pops with occasional very light utensil contact. Warm close realistic kitchen foley, seamless loop, no music, no voices or exaggerated splashes.

A small patch of old asphalt splits under upward pressure, three sharp irregular brittle cracks mixed with coarse gravel grinding. Close, forceful and compact, no explosion. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.
assets.trigger: Cracks become visible before a zombie

assets.prompt: One decayed humanoid slowly climbs out through a person-sized patch of broken asphalt: gritty soil slides, small chunks knock, torn clothing strains, fingers scrape pavement and one low breathless effort groan. One compact three-second rise. Realistic horror-game foley, no music, no speech, no explosion.
assets.trigger: Zombie climbing out of the hole

assets.prompt: One low damaged human-like zombie groan, coarse breath, dry throat texture and an uneven exhale. Wordless, slow and threatening, no intelligible speech, no monster roar or layered crowd. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation.

One close zombie winds up to strike: a short coarse damaged-human rasp and tense aggressive exhale, followed by a quick torn-sleeve swipe through the air. One compact attack, grounded and wordless, no giant monster roar, no impact, no music.

One single 12-gauge pump-shotgun blast in a small open-air roadside camp, a tight sharp crack, weighty short low punch and brief natural outdoor decay. No cycling, no shell drop, no second shot, no automatic fire. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.

One complete pump-shotgun cycle: the wooden fore-end racks firmly backward with crisp sliding metal, then pushes forward into a positive locking clack; one tiny spent-shell tick follows. One short natural sequence, close and dry, no gunshot, no repeated pumping, no voices or music.
assets.trigger: After each shotgun blast; the clip contains both pump strokes and the shell detail

assets.prompt: One close heavy pellet hit into a decayed fictional zombie: a compact wet body thud, short fibrous tear, small brittle crunch and brief blood splatter onto rough asphalt. A single punchy impact for body hits and severed parts, no gunshot, no vocalization, no music.

A heavy limp body in torn clothing collapses onto dry asphalt, a knee scrape, dull torso thud and brief loose cloth rattle. One fall, no voice or weapon sound. Realistic sound for a tiny cyber-apocalyptic diorama. No music, no cinematic stinger, no unrelated sounds. Dry close recording with minimal reverberation. No voices.
assets.trigger: Zombie bodies or severed parts landing; reuse the same file at different volume and pitch

assets.prompt: A small group of decayed zombie remains suddenly catches fire in sunlight: several compact soft ignition whoofs, dry fabric crackles and a restrained oily sizzle that gradually fades to ash over five seconds. One localized burn sequence, no explosion, no voices or music.

A compact patched-together electric corpse-harvester cart runs steadily: low motor whirr, soft under-deck suction, faint conveyor chatter and small caster vibrations. Believable modest machinery, stable seamless loop, no combustion engine, no crushing material, no voices or music.

A compact moving harvester draws soft wet organic material beneath its ground-level hood and grinds it: short gritty scraping, muffled wet compression, fibrous crunching and small minced pieces plopping into a plastic bin. Seamless loaded-machine loop, no screams, no engine bed or music.

One short repair stroke with a steel shovel and thick sticky tar: a gritty metal scoop, dense adhesive pull, a soft heavy deposit into a pavement crack and a brief rough smoothing scrape. Close realistic foley, no watery splash, no voice or music.

One heavy close blow lands on a canvas jacket with a compact dull body slap and brief fabric scrape, immediately followed by a short involuntary pained grunt from an adult man. One grounded restrained hit reaction, wordless, no screaming or music.

A tired adult male survivor collapses: one final strained breath and low wordless groan, a dropped wooden gun makes a small metal-and-wood clack, then his work-clothed body lands on gritty asphalt with a weighty thud and short scrape. One natural two-and-a-half-second death sequence, no music, no dialogue, no dramatic scream.

integration_notes: Trigger the complete pump-cycle file from shotgun-pump-back only; do not layer additional pump-forward or shell files.
Use flesh-impact once for each successful shot; head-impact, limb-sever and blood-spray need no additional generated files.
The death clip includes the gun drop and body fall, so those subevents need no extra files.
Reuse the footsteps and body-landing sounds rather than generating separate minor variants.
